inference_limit: An allocation Boolean is a prior screen decision, not a zero expression measurement, protein absence, exact seven-family test or clinical resistance. Name matches in unrelated genomic tables do not establish antigen RNA evaluations.
prior_family_preservation: Original FDA6 and baseline11 families stay frozen/shelved as adjudicated; fixed new7 remains intact. No silent deletion of previous negatives or addition of targets after seeing values.
novelty_rule: Published primary evidence and consequential unanswered knowledge govern novelty. Prior evaluation is exposure and must be disclosed; an unpublished allocation table alone does not settle scientific value. A useful question may be answered by verified existing data if it is distinct from an old failed claim, preserves original families/exposure and meets full validity/coverage requirements.
